description: This PHP class defines a database migration script for version 5.1.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for updating database schema, inserting permissions, managing language strings, and configuring menu items related to performance reviews and other modules.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for database updates and configuration changes in OrangeHRM version 5.1.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration steps including database schema updates, permission insertions, language string management, and menu configuration.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LangStringHelper.

methods.name: getTranslationHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of TranslationHelper.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings in the database.

methods.name: addValidColumnToRequestResetPassword
methods.description: Adds an 'expired' boolean column to the 'ohrm_reset_password' table.

methods.name: insertModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Inserts default page configuration for a module and user role.

methods.name: insertReviewWorkflowStates
methods.description: Inserts workflow states for review processes for admin and supervisor roles.

methods.name: insertSelfReviewWorkflowStates
methods.description: Inserts workflow states for self-review processes for admin, supervisor, and ESS roles.

methods.name: insertWorkflowState
methods.description: Inserts a single workflow state into the database.

methods.name: insertReviewListScreenForAdminRole
methods.description: Associates a review list screen with the admin user role with specific permissions.

methods.name: modifyThemeTable
methods.description: Alters the 'ohrm_theme' table by dropping, adding, renaming columns, and updating theme variables.

methods.name: modifyTrackerLogsUserForeignKey
methods.description: Modifies foreign key constraints on 'ohrm_performance_tracker_log' table for user_id.

methods.name: modifyEmployeeTrackerScreenRolePermission
methods.description: Updates user role permissions for the 'viewEmployeePerformanceTrackerList' screen.

methods.name: updateMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Updates the menu configuration for a specific module and screen URL.

methods.name: updateRecruitmentMenuItems
methods.description: Updates menu items related to recruitment module.

methods.name: updatePerformanceMenuItems
methods.description: Updates menu items related to performance module.
